title: Straka surges into Hero World Challenge lead with Scheffler one shot back
content: Sepp Straka made three birdies and two eagles on par 5s for an eight-under 64 and seized on some late misses by Scottie Scheffler to take a one-shot lead on Saturday going into the final round of the Hero World Challenge.

title: Bath blitz Munster as Saracens, Bristol win too in Champions Cup
content: An astonishing start which saw Bath 28-0 ahead inside 19 minutes proved crucial as the Prem side saw off Munster 40-14 in their Champions Cup opener.

title: Neville: Arsenal must not 'panic' as City close gap in 'season of inconsistency'
content: Arsenal "must not panic" after defeat at Aston Villa saw Man City close the gap at the top of the Premier League, says Sky Sports' Gary Neville.

title: Neergaard-Petersen holds nerve to beat Smith to Australian Open title

title: Liverpool miss chance to go fifth as last-gasp Leeds deny Slot in thrilling draw
